temporal_resampling.reason: Disabled to keep the first and last sign structure unchanged in the initial pilot.

frame_masking_or_landmark_dropout.reason: Disabled to avoid adding synthetic detection loss before the spatial experiment is evaluated.

horizontal_mirroring.reason: Handedness and semantic preservation have not been proven for this dataset.

missing_hand_policy: Keep all-zero 63-value hand slots exactly zero.
split_policy: Augment training samples only; validation and test remain untouched.
